positions.title: Undergraduate Student Researcher
positions.description: Study the NP-hard Minimum Vertex Clique Cover (VCC) Problem alongside Professor Darren Strash of Hamilton College. Develop and implement code in C++ to efficiently solve the VCC Problem on large graphs. Perform extensive experiments using Bash scripts on Hamilton College's High Performance Computing Cluster. Write proofs of correctness for algorithms to back theory

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: Assist students one-on-one in completing programming assignments primarily in Python and C++. Grade programming projects and exams on a weekly basis. Assist professors and students during lecture.

positions.title: Junior Front-End Developer
positions.description: Develop front-end for websites and IOS applications, using React with Redux. Collaborate in a team of 4-6. Participate in daily team check-ins and/or code review.
